answer_1.quote: Question generation (QG), focusing on the questions derived from specific text passages or documents, plays an integral role in a wide array of domains.

answer_2.quote: We use Rouge-L score, BERTScore, and BLEURT to measure the quality of generated questions. For diversity measurement, we use Self-BLEU score.

answer_4.quote: We hire five annotators, proficient in English as their first foreign language, to further evaluate the diversity and quality of the generated questions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators ranked models on diversity dimensions (type, syntax, content) and rated questions on appropriateness and answerability.
